airspace.zh: 墨西哥由聯邦民航局（AFAC）管理：休閒用超過250公克的無人機須登記；一般最高飛行高度122公尺，須遠離機場至少9.2公里，並避開航空資料上公告的禁航與限航區。
airspace.en: Mexico's Federal Civil Aviation Agency (AFAC) regulates drones: recreational drones over 250 g must be registered; the general ceiling is 122 m, stay at least 9.2 km from aerodromes and out of prohibited and restricted areas listed in the AIP.

castillo.zh: 庫庫爾坎神廟（城堡金字塔）
castillo.note: about 30 m with the temple on top

tagline.zh-Hant: 從古典期晚期到後古典期早期，奇琴伊察的興起與兩次「發現」
tagline.en: The rise of Chichen Itza, from the Late Classic to the early Postclassic

zh: 這裡是墨西哥尤卡坦半島北部的奇琴伊察，一座瑪雅古城。
en: This is Chichen Itza, in the north of Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula: a Maya city.

zh: 城市從古典期晚期，大約公元六〇〇年起，
一直使用到約一二〇〇年。
en: It was occupied from the Late Classic, around AD 600,
into the early Postclassic, around 1200.

zh: 約在八〇〇年，伊察人來到這裡；
「伊察」是一個族群與家族的名稱。
en: The Itza arrived around 800;
the name refers to an ethnic and lineage group.

zh: 九〇〇到一〇五〇年是全盛期，
它控制著半島北部與中部。
en: Its peak came between 900 and 1050,
as a regional capital ruling north and central Yucatán.

zh: 遺址最早的象形文字日期相當於八三二年，
最晚的是九九八年。
en: The earliest hieroglyphic date here equals AD 832;
the last known date is from 998.

zh: 建築混合了瑪雅風格與墨西哥中部的風格，
也有普克與切內斯樣式。
en: The buildings mix Maya styles with those of central Mexico,
plus Puuc and Chenes forms.

zh: 戰士神廟的格局，
和托爾特克首都圖拉的B神廟相似。
en: The Temple of the Warriors complex
resembles Temple B at Tula, the Toltec capital.

zh: 今天多數學者認為，那是文化交流，
不是一場移民或征服。
en: Most scholars now see this as cultural diffusion,
not migration or conquest.

zh: 1904到1910年，美國人愛德華・湯普森
在北邊的聖井打撈文物。
en: From 1904 to 1910 Edward Thompson
dredged the Sacred Cenote to the north.

zh: 卡內基研究院在1925到1928年，
挖掘並修復了戰士神廟。
en: The Carnegie Institution excavated and restored
the Temple of the Warriors from 1925 to 1928.

zh: 1988年，奇琴伊察列入世界遺產。
en: In 1988 Chichen Itza was inscribed as World Heritage.

zh: 2007年，城堡金字塔在全球票選中
名列「世界新七大奇蹟」。
en: In 2007 El Castillo was named one of the New 7 Wonders
after a worldwide vote.

zh: 遺址是聯邦財產，由國家人類學與歷史研究院管理；
2010年州政府買下主要古蹟下方的土地。
en: The ruins are federal property, run by INAH;
in 2010 the state of Yucatán bought the land beneath the main monuments.

zh: 一座城市的興衰，
大約橫跨六百年。
en: The city's rise and decline
spans some six centuries.

title.en: A Ball Court, an Observatory and a Sacred Well

tagline.zh-Hant: 奇琴伊察的公共建築，以及它們留下的問題
tagline.en: Chichen Itza's public buildings, and the questions they leave

zh: 奇琴伊察有一整片公共建築，
從空中看最清楚。
en: Chichen Itza has a whole precinct of public buildings,
easiest to read from the air.

zh: 大球場長一百六十八公尺、寬七十公尺，
是中美洲保存最好的球場。
en: The Great Ball Court is 168 by 70 metres,
the largest and best preserved in ancient Mesoamerica.

zh: 兩側平行的平台各長九十五公尺，
牆高八公尺。
en: Its parallel platforms are each 95 metres long,
with walls 8 metres high.

zh: 城堡金字塔正中，
春分秋分前後會出現「蛇影」。
en: At the centre stands El Castillo;
around the equinoxes a "serpent" appears on it.

zh: 傍晚的三角形陰影落在北側階梯的欄杆上，
像一條蛇往下爬。
en: Late-afternoon triangles of shadow fall on the northern balustrade
like a serpent descending the stairs.

zh: 不過這個光影會持續好幾個星期，
學者認為不太可能是刻意用來標記日期。
en: But the effect lasts several weeks,
so scholars think it unlikely to have been built to mark dates.

zh: 戰士神廟前排滿雕著戰士的石柱，
階梯頂端有一尊查克莫爾像。
en: The Temple of the Warriors is fronted by carved warrior columns;
a Chac Mool figure sits at the top of the stairs.

zh: 蝸牛塔是一座圓形建築，
裡面有螺旋石階，約建於九〇六年。
en: El Caracol is a round building with a spiral stair inside,
dated to around AD 906.

zh: 它可能是天文台：二十九種天象裡，
有二十種能在建築中找到對應的視線。
en: It may have been an observatory: of 29 astronomical events,
sight lines for 20 can be found in the structure.

zh: 瑪雅人知道金星週期約五八四天，
五個週期正好等於八個太陽年。
en: The Maya knew Venus repeats every 584 days,
and that five Venus cycles equal eight solar years.

zh: 頭骨台上的頭骨是直立排列的，
不同於高原上的橫向排法。
en: On the Tzompantli, the skull platform, skulls were set vertically,
unlike the horizontal racks of the highlands.

zh: 北邊的聖井直徑約六十公尺，
井壁下方約二十七公尺才是水面。
en: To the north, the Sacred Cenote is about 60 metres across,
its water some 27 metres below the rim.

zh: 井裡撈出黃金、玉、陶器、香料與人骨；
是否全是人祭，至今仍有爭議。
en: Gold, jade, pottery, incense and human remains came out of it;
whether all were sacrifices is still debated.

zh: 2017年有兩百六十萬名遊客來到這裡。
en: In 2017, 2.6 million visitors came here.

tagline.zh-Hant: 石灰岩、天然井與地底河，奇琴伊察為什麼建在這裡
tagline.en: Limestone, cenotes and underground rivers: why the city stands here

zh: 從空中看尤卡坦半島北部，
一片平坦的綠色。
en: From the air, northern Yucatán
is a flat expanse of green.

zh: 這裡是石灰岩喀斯特地形，
地面上沒有河流或溪流。
en: This is limestone karst country,
with no rivers or streams on the surface.

zh: 內陸的河流，都在地底下流動。
en: Inland, the rivers run underground.

zh: 人們取水靠的是天然井，
也就是石灰岩塌陷後露出地下水的井洞。
en: People drew water from cenotes:
sinkholes where the limestone has given way to the water table.

zh: 奇琴伊察一帶有四個看得到的天然井，
終年有水，吸引人在此定居。
en: Four visible cenotes here gave water all year
and made the site attractive for settlement.

zh: 北邊的聖井，
和城市以一條石砌大道相連。
en: The Sacred Cenote to the north
is joined to the city by a raised causeway.

zh: 2015年，科學家判定
庫庫爾坎神廟底下還藏著一個天然井。
en: In 2015 scientists determined that a hidden cenote
lies beneath the Temple of Kukulcán.

zh: 考古學家至今沒有親眼見過它。
en: Archaeologists have never seen it.

zh: 往東南約三公里，
是伊基爾天然井。
en: About three kilometres south-east
is the Ik Kil cenote.

zh: 井口往下，可以看到地下水面。
en: Through the opening the groundwater comes into view.

zh: 再往東，是巴蘭坎切洞穴。
en: Farther east lies the cave of Balankanché.

zh: 這是一處瑪雅人使用過的洞穴遺址。
en: It is a cave site used by the Maya.

zh: 城市往四面八方鋪出八十多條石砌大道。
en: More than 80 causeways, sacbeob, spread from the city in every direction.

zh: 在沒有河的土地上，
城市跟著水井而生。
en: In a land without rivers,
the city grew where the water was.

tagline.zh-Hant: 庫庫爾坎神廟、大道與天然井的尺寸
tagline.en: The measurements of El Castillo, the causeway and the cenote

zh: 這部影片用尺寸來看奇琴伊察。
en: This film reads Chichen Itza through its measurements.

zh: 城堡金字塔約三十公尺高，
頂上還有一座六公尺的神廟。
en: El Castillo is about 30 metres high,
with a 6-metre temple on top.

zh: 它由九層方形平台疊成，
每層約二點五七公尺高。
en: It is built of nine square terraces,
each about 2.57 metres high.

zh: 底座每邊約五十五點三公尺，
四面各有一道階梯。
en: Its base measures about 55.3 metres a side,
with a stairway on each of the four faces.

zh: 階梯的坡度是四十五度。
en: The stairways climb at 45 degrees.

zh: 大球場一百六十八乘七十公尺，
球場牆高八公尺。
en: The Great Ball Court measures 168 by 70 metres;
its walls are 8 metres high.

zh: 一號大道從城堡金字塔往北，通往聖井。
en: Sacbe Number One runs north from El Castillo to the Sacred Cenote.

zh: 大道長約二百七十公尺，
平均寬約九公尺。
en: It is about 270 metres long
and averages 9 metres wide.

zh: 聖井直徑約六十公尺，
垂直的井壁往下約二十七公尺。
en: The Sacred Cenote is about 60 metres across,
with sheer walls dropping some 27 metres.

zh: 湯普森1909年曾潛入井中，
說底部有一層約五公尺厚的藍色顏料。
en: Thompson dived into it in 1909
and reported a layer of blue pigment about 5 metres thick.

zh: 從上面看，主要建築都散布在一大片
平坦的廣場與林地之間。
en: From above, the main buildings are scattered
across flat plazas and woodland.

zh: 往西南約二十公里，
是另一座瑪雅遺址亞舒納。
en: About twenty kilometres south-west
is another Maya site, Yaxuná.

zh: 半島上的瑪雅城市，
散布在同一片平坦的石灰岩台地上。
en: The peninsula's Maya cities
are spread across the same flat limestone platform.

zh: 九層平台、四道階梯、一條大道與一口井，
組成了這座城市的骨架。
en: Nine terraces, four stairways, a causeway and a well
make up the skeleton of the city.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Pre-Hispanic City of Chichen-Itza
